resources.name: Gibbs energy functions for pure SrO (Taylor & Dinsdale 1990)

access.notes: J.R. Taylor, A.T. Dinsdale, Z. Metallkd. 81 (1990) 354–366. The published polynomials provide G(T) for liquid and halite SrO.

access.notes: D. Risold, B. Hallstedt, L.J. Gauckler, Calphad 20 (1996) 353–361. The paper reports G(T) polynomials for liquid and halite NiO.
